title: Blue Angel Closes its First Partnership with leading Concierge Physicians Dr. Amy Daniher and Dr. Ulrike Sujansky
paragraphs: Blue Angel Clinical Partners today announced a partnership with Dr. Rika Sujansky and Dr. Daniher, representing the company's first partnership in the Bay Area.

Through this collaboration, Blue Angel Clinical Partners will support the practice by enhancing clinic operations, reducing administrative burden for physicians and staff, and improving the overall patient experience. The partnership is designed to allow clinicians to focus more fully on delivering high-quality, personalized care, while Blue Angel provides operational, financial, and strategic support.

The partnership marks an important milestone as Blue Angel Clinical Partners continues to expand its presence in the Bay Area and beyond. The company plans to partner with additional physicians as it builds a premier network of concierge physicians dedicated to delivering an elevated, patient-centered healthcare experience.

title: Blue Angel Clinical Partners Completes Its $15M Fundraise to Accelerate the Growth of Concierge Medicine
paragraphs: Blue Angel Clinical Partners announced the close of $15 million in funding led by Footbridge Partners, Granite Point Partners, and TTCER Partners.

This investment will accelerate the development of the Blue Angel platform, which empowers top-tier concierge physicians to launch and grow independent practices. By providing comprehensive administrative and operational support, Blue Angel enables doctors to focus exclusively on delivering personalized, high-quality patient care.

The investor group brings years of healthcare operations experience to the partnership. The funding round also includes participation from many former and current healthcare CEOs, adding significant strategic value and industry expertise to the company's trajectory.
The capital will be used to expand the team, enhance the technology platform, and grow the network of Blue Angel practices in the Bay Area and beyond.
